description: Flask service with seeded gaps in CI, security, tests, dependencies, and claims.

must_find.REPO-01: README has no requirements or validation command
must_find.QUAL-02: no formatting, linting, or type checking
must_find.QUAL-03: CI runs `pytest || true`, so failing tests never fail the job
must_find.DEP-01: requirements.txt is unpinned and there is no lockfile
must_find.TEST-01: only the happy path is tested; invalid input and failures are not
must_find.TEST-02: unit tests call an external host
must_find.CI-01: CI uses python-version 3.x and unpinned dependencies
must_find.CI-02: actions are pinned to tags instead of commit SHAs
must_find.CI-03: no permissions block, and checkout persists credentials by default
must_find.SEC-02: the stock count is not validated and there is no authorization
must_find.SEC-03: the warehouse request has no timeout
must_find.SEC-04: the server listens on 0.0.0.0 with debug=True
must_find.ARCH-05: a broad `except Exception: pass` hides failures
must_find.PERF-01: the README claims 10,000 requests per second without measurements

must_not_flag.STRUCT-02: fewer than 20 files in every directory
must_not_flag.TOOL-01: no tools, skills, or MCP servers configured
